purpose: Use the locked event-blind v3 architecture as the baseline for schedule-aware England tournament forecasts
event_blind_refit_rule: fit once per tournament edition through two local dates before its first England fixture
retrospective_diagnostic_status: previously opened; not a new holdout
correction_validation: leave one complete historical tournament edition out
primary_metric: pooled MAE over the union of pregame, scheduled-match and postmatch windows
